A waxed, snakeskin effect material with: A waxed, snakeskin effect material with a mottled finish. Each skin is first drum-dyed to establish the base colour, then embossed to create the snake texture. Wax is applied to achieve the characteristic two-tone effect.Once the desired surface effect is reached, shiny paper is applied to refine both the emboss depth and surface sheen. The skins are then milled in drums to bring out the contrast between tones. This stage requires careful control: over-milling can flatten the emboss and reduce contrast, while under-milling will prevent the two-tone effect from fully emerging.
